diySteps: If H2O appears only during a 1-Hour Wash cycle, schedule service; you can run any other cycle until service is done
If it appears during AutoSense, Heavy, Normal or Light cycles, double-check that the inlet water hose is not kinked
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If neither case applies, GE says to call for service.
